newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SUMMER TRADING KEEPS ACTIVITY AND INTEREST LOW.
newsitem.headline: SUMMER TRADING KEEPS ACTIVITY AND INTEREST LOW.

text.p: * Total trade on the Estonian bourse on Monday was 22.6
million kroons versus Friday's 32.2 million kroons.
* The Talse index lost 0.77 percent to close at 250.21.
* Hansapank was the most active with turnover of
6.7 million kroons to drop 2.31 kroons to 127.55 kroons.
* On the free market, EMV registered trade of 1.5
million kroons to close 35 kroons lower at 640 kroons.
* Dealers said the low volumes and aimlessness of the market
is a symptom of summer with little change in activity expected
over the next month.
Trade on the Estonian bourse on
Monday was subdued with summer blamed for the waning interest
and low volumes, dealers said.
Total trade on the main list was 26.8 million kroons with
the Talse 0.77 percent lower at 250.21.
"There is almost no volume at all and a summer trend of
mixed prices, but most stocks are stable," one dealer said.
"However, it looks like summer has come early, so autumn
may as well too...the market might pick up again after the
banks release their half year results," he added.
Hansapank was the most active to shed 2.31 kroons for a
close at 127.55 kroons after registering trade of 6.7 million
kroons.
The free market turned over 5.5 million kroons, with EMV, a
construction company, the most active by a small margin.
EMV saw trade of 1.5 million kroons to lose 35 kroons after
closing at 640 kroons.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom, +372 630 8400
reuters@reuters.ee
